hooks.name: Deploy Gate - Block deploy skill
hooks.description: Forces IDE popup when activating deploy-to-vercel skill.

action.command: zsh -c 'INPUT=$(cat); SKILL=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"toolInput\",{}).get(\"name\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$SKILL" == "deploy-to-vercel" ]]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"⛔ Deploy a producción requiere tu aprobación. ¿Permitir?\"}}"; fi; exit 0'

hooks.name: Deploy Gate - Block vercel CLI and git push main
hooks.description: Forces IDE popup when running vercel deploy or git push to main.

action.command: zsh -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"toolInput\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "vercel deploy|vercel.*--prod|git push.*main|git merge.*main"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"⛔ Este comando afecta producción/main. ¿Aprobar?\"}}"; fi; exit 0'
